honesty_note: The Poissonnier 2026 open-arena outcomes, failures of H2-v1/H3-v1/H4-v1, the H5 measurement reconstruction, and all H5 mechanism stress audits were known before this estimator policy was frozen. This is an internal development estimation and model-comparison policy, not independent validation or blind preregistration.

mechanism_freeze.rule: The biological mechanism is frozen. Estimator implementation may wire only the already-frozen H5-v1 mechanism and may not alter origin, temporal profile, effect scope, radial gate, history representation, or search dispersion.

scope: DCM-control 200 mm versus 1000 mm recent constrained travel, open-arena outcomes only
colony_identity_rule: Colony identity may be used only to define leave-one-colony-out train/holdout partitions, exclude held-out geometry from the estimator geometry pool, and report fold results. Colony identity may not be supplied to the simulated ant, H5 biology, protocol state, or treatment logic.

baseline_mean_free_path_mm.provenance: Copied unchanged from the frozen H3 estimator family because H5 reuses the H3-null continuous-time run-and-reorientation substrate.
baseline_mean_free_path_mm.sharing_rule: Within any fitted null/common/history candidate, one ell0 is shared across both 200 mm and 1000 mm conditions. The three nested models are fitted independently but use the same definition, bounds, Halton coordinate, trial seeds, and geometry policy.

baseline_turn_concentration.provenance: Copied unchanged from the frozen H3 estimator family. H5 search dispersion is frozen by identity to this same candidate value.
baseline_turn_concentration.sharing_rule: One kappa_turn is shared across treatments and between the ordinary H3-null reorientation component and the H5 origin-search component.
baseline_turn_concentration.numerical_rule: The deterministic high-resolution Halton candidate mapping does not sample either endpoint and, for indices 1..500, produces kappa in [0.027434842249657063,19.945130315500684], so the known H3 sampler convergence seam at approximately 1e-8 to 1.1e-8 is unreachable by the frozen high-resolution search.
baseline_turn_concentration.exact_zero_rule: kappa_turn=0 is a mathematically valid behavioral boundary but is not generated by the frozen Halton search. No manual kappa=0 candidate may be injected into the reference search. If a future separately versioned estimator includes exact zero, its H5 origin-search effect is directionally degenerate and cannot itself support an H5 mechanism claim.

entry_orientation_retention_q.rule: Same q in 200 mm and 1000 mm conditions. It may not depend on treatment, history amplitude, colony, or geometry row.

alpha_search_common.rule: Used only in the equal-strength common-origin-search comparator, where alpha_search_200=alpha_search_1000=alpha_common.

alpha_search_endpoints.rule: These are the only H5-v1 history-effect amplitudes. They are defined only at recent_constrained_travel_mm exactly 200 or 1000; interpolation/extrapolation is forbidden.

fixed_parameters: entry_position_distribution except frozen per-trial reconstructed first-track coordinates
H5 biological origin = frozen central physical entry reference
H5 temporal profile = constant over observed traversal
H5 radial gate = frozen boundary-normalized linear rule
H5 search dispersion = shared baseline kappa_turn
fixed_parameter_rule: Every model, protocol, state, apparatus, scoring, observation, geometry, or H5 mechanism quantity not explicitly listed under estimated_parameters remains fixed. The estimator may not silently introduce additional nuisance or H5 parameters.

H5_null.interpretation: Shared H3-null locomotion substrate with H5 dedicated choice/search RNG cadence present but behaviorally inert.

H5_common_search.interpretation: Generic origin-referenced search of equal strength after 200 mm and 1000 mm. This can support a generic origin-search claim but cannot support recent-travel history modulation.

H5_history.interpretation: History-modulated origin search. This is the H5-v1 scientific alternative.

entry_transition_model.definition: With probability q preserve the protocol-sampled post-transition heading; otherwise draw heading uniformly on [-pi,pi).
entry_transition_model.rule: Reuse the existing H2/H3/H4 entry-transition stream for matched common-random-number compatibility.

forbidden_fit_observables: any reconstructed movement-state quantity dependent on the unrecovered AnimalTA movement classifier
post-reorientation angle distributions not present in the frozen aggregate target file
Y-maze decision/correct or any Y-maze-derived statistic

objective.compatibility_rule: Use the corrected audited H3/H4 scorer without H5-specific reweighting.
objective.continuous_distance: 19-quantile Wasserstein-1 divided by pooled training-colony SD.
objective.categorical_distance: 2 * Hellinger distance for normalized five-category exit distribution.
objective.aggregation: Equal-weight mean squared component distance across 4 metrics x 2 history conditions.
objective.heldout_scaling: For each LOCO fold, compute continuous metric SDs from the five real training colonies once and freeze them for null/common/history and all cross-family held-out evaluations.

measurement_application.geometry_pool_rule: For held-out colony c, simulated training and held-out evaluation trials draw geometry uniformly with replacement only from frozen geometry rows belonging to the other five colonies. Held-out colony geometry is excluded even for held-out simulation generation.
measurement_application.candidate_independence: For a given trial seed, geometry row is identical across null/common/history candidates and across short/long conditions. Candidate parameters may not alter geometry selection.
measurement_application.short_long_pairing: The same trial seed uses the same sampled geometry row in 200 mm and 1000 mm conditions.
measurement_application.application: Apply sampled width/height, first-track observation start, zero position jitter, central physical origin, and 10 mm middle-zone half-width exactly as frozen in the measurement policy.
measurement_application.comparator_rule: Historical H2/H3/H4 fold candidates must also be re-evaluated under this same reconstructed per-trial geometry without refitting.

rng_contract.cadence: At every ordinary H3-null reorientation event, all three H5 nested models consume one dedicated H5 choice variate and one dedicated H5 search-angle draw. Null/common/history therefore have matched H5 RNG cadence; only the selection rule differs.
rng_contract.inert_draw_rule: Under H5-null or whenever the search component is not selected, dedicated H5 draws may not affect baseline trajectory, H3 event timing, or H3 baseline turn RNG.

fitting_order: Fit H5_common_search second with an exact null anchor copied from the selected H5_null candidate.
Fit H5_history third with both an exact common-search anchor copied from the selected H5_common_search candidate and an exact null anchor copied from the selected H5_null candidate.
cross_validation.matched_evaluation_rule: Within each fold, selected null/common/history candidates are evaluated on identical held-out reference rows using identical evaluation trial counts, trial seeds, reconstructed geometry draws, entry-transition CRN stream, training-derived metric scales, and matched H5 dedicated RNG cadence.
cross_validation.primary_history_modulation_guard: H5_history must have lower held-out loss than H5_common_search in at least 5 of 6 folds and strictly positive median relative held-out improvement versus H5_common_search.
cross_validation.exact_null_guard: H5_history must also have lower held-out loss than H5_null in at least 5 of 6 folds and strictly positive median relative held-out improvement versus H5_null.
cross_validation.common_search_report_only: H5_common_search versus H5_null is reported fold-by-fold and in aggregate. Passing or failing that comparison does not substitute for the primary H5_history versus H5_common_search guard.
cross_validation.anchor_implication: If H5_history selects the exact common-search anchor in a fold, matched evaluation must be exactly equal to H5_common_search in that fold and therefore cannot count as a strict history-modulation win. The analogous rule applies to the exact null anchor.

search_protocol.trial_seed_rule: Within a fold and phase, trial seed = fold seed + trial_index. The same trial seed set is reused for every candidate and both history conditions.
search_protocol.null_candidate_set: 500 three-dimensional Halton candidates using indices 1..500 and primes 2,3,5.
search_protocol.common_candidate_set: 499 four-dimensional Halton candidates using indices 1..499 and primes 2,3,5,7, plus one exact null anchor copied from the fold-selected H5_null nuisance candidate with alpha_common=0.
search_protocol.history_candidate_set: 498 five-dimensional Halton candidates using indices 1..498 and primes 2,3,5,7,11. For each Halton candidate set alpha_search_200=max(u7,u11) and alpha_search_1000=min(u7,u11). Add one exact common-search anchor copied from the fold-selected H5_common_search candidate with equal endpoint amplitudes, plus one exact null anchor copied from the fold-selected H5_null candidate with both amplitudes zero.
search_protocol.monotone_triangle_reason: Sorting the two unit Halton amplitude coordinates covers the allowed endpoint triangle without introducing an extra curve parameter or privileging one endpoint through an arbitrary nonlinear history law.
search_protocol.nuisance_coordinate_pairing: For Halton indices 1..498, ell0, kappa_turn, and q coordinates are identical across H5_null, H5_common_search, and H5_history. Index 499 nuisance coordinates are paired between null and common; null alone additionally uses index 500.
search_protocol.duplicate_anchor_rule: If the selected common-search candidate is itself the exact null anchor, the history candidate set still contains both required anchor records even though they are trajectory-equivalent. Do not conditionally replace the duplicate with an extra favorable Halton candidate.

safe_kappa_support.rule: No manual tiny-positive kappa candidate may be injected. Changing candidate count, Halton mapping, or kappa coordinate mapping requires a separately versioned estimator policy because it could change seam reachability.

search_firewall: No hand-injected favorable candidate other than the required exact nesting anchors.
No bound widening or narrowing after inspecting H5 results.
No candidate-budget increase after inspecting H5 results.
No alternate seeds after inspecting H5 results.
No objective modification after inspecting H5 results.
No changing the monotone alpha coordinate mapping after inspecting H5 results.
search_protocol.smoke_test_rule: A low-resolution run may verify execution only. Its losses, selected parameters, or fold comparisons are not evidence and may not alter any frozen search choice.

comparator_policy.no_refit_rule: H2/H3/H4 candidates are frozen historical candidates and may not be refit, retuned, or replaced using H5 outcomes.
comparator_policy.matched_reevaluation: For each H5 LOCO fold, re-evaluate the corresponding frozen H2/H3/H4 candidate on the H5 held-out reference rows with the same evaluation trial count, fold evaluation seed, reconstructed geometry policy, training-derived scorer scales, and shared entry-transition stream wherever applicable.
comparator_policy.architecture_CRN_rule: Use identical trial seeds, geometry draws, and shared entry-transition randomness across families. Other biological RNG streams may differ where architectures are not isomorphic; do not claim stronger CRN matching than the architectures permit.
comparator_policy.H2_guard: After H5 passes its own common-search and null guards, H5_history must beat matched H2-v1 in at least 4 of 6 folds and have strictly positive median relative improvement versus H2-v1 to be called development-preferred over H2-v1.
comparator_policy.H3_guard: After H5 passes its own guards, H5_history must beat matched H3-v1 in at least 4 of 6 folds and have strictly positive median relative improvement versus H3-v1 to be called development-preferred over H3-v1.
comparator_policy.H4_guard: After H5 passes its own guards, H5_history must beat matched H4-v1 in at least 4 of 6 folds and have strictly positive median relative improvement versus H4-v1 to be called development-preferred over H4-v1.
comparator_policy.cross_family_interpretation: Cross-family rankings are secondary. They cannot rescue failure of H5_history versus H5_common_search or H5_null.

synthetic_estimator_qualification.purpose: Verify estimator/runtime wiring and numerical invariants before high-resolution reference search.
required_checks: H5_null selected nuisance candidate is trajectory-identical to its exact null anchor for matched seeds.
H5_common_search exact null anchor is trajectory-identical to H5_null.
H5_history exact common anchor is trajectory-identical to H5_common_search.
H5_history exact null anchor is trajectory-identical to H5_null.
alpha_search_200=max(u7,u11) and alpha_search_1000=min(u7,u11) wiring is exact for diagnostic Halton points.
Only recent_constrained_travel_mm exact values 200 and 1000 are accepted by H5 history lookup.
The 200 and 1000 conditions use the same sampled geometry for the same trial seed.
Held-out colony geometry is excluded from every fold geometry pool, including held-out simulation generation.
H5 choice/search draws consume matched cadence and do not perturb H3 event or baseline-turn streams.
H5 direction-only mechanism does not alter event timing.
Shared kappa_turn is used by both baseline and search directional components.
Five-category exit scoring including timeout is normalized.
Held-out continuous scaling uses training-colony SDs only.
Cross-family comparator candidate extraction loads exactly six pinned historical fold candidates per family.
Colony identity is not a biological input.
synthetic_estimator_qualification.anti_tuning_rule: Qualification may identify implementation or policy-transcription defects only. It may not use reference losses to change bounds, search coordinates, budgets, seeds, objective, comparator set, or promotion guards.

required_effective_quantities: A1(kappa_turn), the first circular moment of the shared von Mises concentration
identifiability_and_reporting.kappa_boundary_rule: Because exact kappa=0 is directionally degenerate and the high-resolution Halton search does not sample it, do not extrapolate a selected positive candidate to an exact-zero mechanism claim. Candidates repeatedly near the lower practical search support indicate weak directional identifiability.
identifiability_and_reporting.search_boundary_warning: A selected scientific or nuisance parameter repeatedly within 1% of its nominal frozen bound is not considered point-identified.
identifiability_and_reporting.anchor_reporting: Report which folds selected exact null or exact common anchors in training.
identifiability_and_reporting.ridge_rule: If alpha amplitudes and kappa_turn trade off while P200/P1000/delta_P are stable, report the effective directional pulls/ridge rather than implying uniquely identified raw amplitudes.
identifiability_and_reporting.no_continuous_history_curve_claim: Do not infer lambda_search, a half-distance, interpolation, or behavior at any L other than 200 and 1000.

promotion_and_interpretation.minimum_internal_history_claim: Requires both the primary history-modulation guard versus H5_common_search and the exact-null guard versus H5_null.
promotion_and_interpretation.generic_origin_search_claim: H5_common_search may be described as internally development-supported generic origin search only if it independently beats H5_null in at least 5 of 6 folds with positive median relative improvement. This claim is separate from history modulation.
promotion_and_interpretation.overall_development_preference: To call H5-v1 development-preferred among H2-v1/H3-v1/H4-v1/H5-v1, H5 must first pass its own two guards and then pass all three 4-of-6 positive-median cross-family guards.
promotion_and_interpretation.no_independent_validation_claim: Passing these guards remains internal development evidence only.
promotion_and_interpretation.canonical_rule: No estimation tool may modify canonical model files automatically. Even a complete pass creates at most a development-preferred H5 candidate pending a separate explicit scientific decision.

post_fit_diagnostics_only: post-reorientation angle summaries reconstructed from simulated trajectories
search-component selection fraction by radial bin
effective P200/P1000 through realized event radii
post_fit_rule: Diagnostics may be inspected only after candidate selection and held-out scoring are complete and may not retroactively affect parameter choice, bounds, objective, pass/fail status, or variant choice.
pooled_fit_rule: An all-six-colony pooled H5 fit may be run only after the complete LOCO decision is frozen. It is descriptive parameter summarization only. For pooled descriptive geometry only, all 51 geometry rows may be used as permitted by the frozen measurement policy. It cannot alter LOCO decisions or rescue failure.
failure_rule: Do not widen or narrow H5 or nuisance parameter ranges in response to failure.
Do not change alpha coordinate mapping in response to failure.
Do not add a separate search concentration, radial scale, temporal decay, free-path effect, or other rejected mechanism after failure.
Do not change objective weights or observables.
Do not change required winning-fold counts.
Do not rerun with favorable seeds.
Do not increase candidate or trial budgets after inspecting results.
Do not use pooled refitting to rescue a failed LOCO guard.
A subsequent hypothesis must be substantively different or justified by genuinely new evidence.
implementation_error_rule: If a genuine implementation defect is found, declare affected executions invalid, document and regression-test the defect, and rerun the entire frozen procedure unchanged. Poor scientific performance, bound-hitting, or noisy folds are not implementation errors.
holdout_rule: The Y-maze may not be loaded, queried, simulated against reference outcomes, used for fitting, candidate ranking, stopping rules, search refinement, model selection, promotion decisions, or choosing among H5 variants.

authorization_after_freeze.persistent_H5_runtime_implementation: allowed only to implement this frozen mechanism and this estimator contract
authorization_after_freeze.reference_parameter_search: still forbidden until persistent runtime and estimator pass the required synthetic qualification
authorization_after_freeze.high_resolution_reference_search: allowed only after a separate exact-head qualification record shows all required checks pass
